name: @repo/server
description: The Inteligir node backend behind createHost() — the composition root over the extracted capability packages (@repo/storage, @repo/vault, @repo/voice, @repo/connectors, @repo/sync): boot/ wires their install seams + the @repo/agent AgentPorts, and keeps the handlers, transport (ws host), app machine, provider, knowledge host shell, delegation, capture, and restore (the AI-edit undo). Node-only — the iso wire contract lives in @repo/bridge. Exports are NARROW on purpose: exactly the entrypoints the desktop main process composes; everything else is package-private.
